_taxonomy.rule: See You In Laos is not a food blog (Owner, 19 Sep 2026): a restaurant, café or bar is shown by its interior, design, architecture, exterior, dining room, counter or atmosphere — never by an isolated dish, plate, bowl, dessert or glass. The category of a place follows its roles (club → club; bar → bar; cafe → cafe; a meal role → restaurant; experience / place → venue context). Every frame carries its kind; src/build-experience-galleries.cjs refuses a record that breaks the rule.
